title: Vice President, Practice Management
description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.

The Vice President, Practice Management is a senior leadership role responsible for establishing and executing the national strategy for advisor productivity, practice management, and growth across the Wealth Advisory Group.

This role serves as a key member of the leadership team and is accountable for accelerating advisor success through scalable practice management frameworks, business development initiatives, and advisor coaching strategies. This role will build the training and support framework to develop and attract advisors, deliver a leading client experience that is consistent, repeatable and powered where possible by common tools, technology and training.

Working closely with Regional Leaders, Business Development leaders, Operations, Compliance, Marketing, and Technology teams, the Vice President will drive advisor recruitment success, increase advisor productivity, improve client experience, and support the long-term growth of the advisor business.
The successful candidate combines deep wealth management expertise, strong commercial acumen, and proven leadership capabilities with the ability to influence advisors and senior stakeholders across multiple regions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a national advisor practice management strategy aligned with the firm's growth objectives.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on advisor experience, advisor productivity, recruiting effectiveness, and business growth opportunities.
  • Establish long-term priorities, success metrics, and operating plans to support advisor acquisition, integration, retention, and practice growth.
  • Lead initiatives that enhance advisor engagement and client experience across the network.

Practice Management & Advisor Growth

  • Build and lead a comprehensive practice management platform focused on advisor growth, client acquisition, practice optimization, succession planning, and operational excellence.
  • Establish best practices across business planning, client segmentation, service models, workflow management, and advisor operating models.
  • Develop scalable coaching programs that support business development, advisor effectiveness, productivity, and profitability.
  • Identify opportunities to increase advisor adoption of practice management tools, technology solutions, and growth programs.
  • Drive initiatives that enhance advisor performance and strengthen competitive differentiation in the marketplace.

Advisor Productivity & Performance

  • Support establishment of key performance indicators and benchmarks for advisor success.
  • Partner with RVP’s to identify performance gaps and implement targeted growth and improvement plans.
  • Analyze advisor productivity trends and develop strategies that support business growth, asset gathering, and client retention.
  • Support advisors in maximizing practice value and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team focused on practice management excellence.
  • Work closely with Compliance, Operations, Technology, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure seamless advisor support and execution.
  • Champion technology adoption and digital enablement initiatives that improve advisor and client experiences.
  • Influence organizational priorities and advocate for advisor needs across the enterprise.

Business Development & Advisor Recruitment Support

  • Partner with business development leaders to attract high-quality advisors and advisor teams to the organization.
  • Participate in strategic recruitment efforts by communicating the firm's advisor value proposition, onboarding capabilities, and practice management offerings.
  • Support advisor transition planning and integration strategies that maximize recruiting success and retention outcomes.

CI Financial is an independent company offering global wealth management and asset management advisory services through diverse financial services firms. Since 1965, we have consistently anticipated and responded to the changing needs of investors. We are driven by a commitment to provide individuals and institutions with the highest-quality investments and advice. Our commitment to the highest levels of performance means that whatever their position, CI employees must be comfortable in a fast-paced environment that will stretch them to tap into their highest potential. Employees with a healthy dose of ambition, a desire to commit to a curious mindset for continuous learning, and a willingness to go the extra mile thrive at CI.

A Supportive Environment for Success

We offer an in-office environment, competitive benefits, and a supportive workplace to help our employees thrive both personally and professionally.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Modern HQ location within walking distance from Union Station
  • Training Reimbursement
  • Paid Professional Designations
  • Employee Savings Plan (ESP)
  • Corporate Discount Program
  • Enhanced group benefits
  • Parental Leave Top–up program
  • Paid time off for Volunteering

title: Sr. Scientist
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Pall Corporation, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in high-tech filtration, separation, and purification, Pall Corporation thrives on helping our customers solve their toughest challenges. Our products serve diverse, global customer needs across a wide range of applications to advance health, safety and environmentally responsible technologies. From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper—everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. For the exponentially curious, Pall is a place where you can thrive and amplify your impact on the world. Find what drives you on a team with a more than 75-year history of discovery, determination, and innovation.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

We are seeking a Senior Scientist to join our Global R&D organization. In this role you will be responsible for leading projects focused on the development, validation, and execution of advanced analytical methods for chemical, structural, and performance characterization of filtration media and integrated filtration, purification, and separation devices or systems for Microelectronics, Food & Beverage, and Energy applications.

This role will focus on analytical methods for trace-level detection of particles, inorganic and organic molecular contaminants and media properties characterization, including chemical, structural, surface properties, porosity, and related material-performance and cleanliness attributes.

The Senior Scientist is expected to work independently within established processes, follow best laboratory safety practices, and provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary projects.

This position reports to an R&D Lab Manager in our Metrology, Analysis and Applications group and is an on-site role located in Cortland, New York, USA.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader to cross-functional teams while identifying method improvements and coordinating laboratory activities, including test planning, scheduling, method readiness, preventive maintenance, and vendor interactions.
  • Lead projects to develop, validate, refine and execute methods for trace-level chemical analysis of metals, extractables, leachables, organics, and other critical contaminants.
  • Lead the characterization of chemical composition, morphology, porosity, surface area, surface energy, thermal behavior, viscoelastic properties, and associated performance attributes of all components of filtration, purification, and separation devices.
  • Uphold all safety, quality, and laboratory compliance requirements.
  • Document experimental methods, data, analysis, conclusions, and recommendations in laboratory notebooks, technical reports, and project summaries

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific or engineering discipline, with 3+ years of hands-on analytical laboratory experience or equivalent relevant experience.

  • High-end filtration evaluation, characterization or development experience
  • Chemical characterization using chromatographic, spectrometric, and spectroscopic tools such as LC-MS, GC-MS, ICP-MS, Ion Chromatography (IC), GPC, UV-VIS, Raman and IR spectroscopy.

title: Head of Organic Growth
description:
Company Overview


Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.

We are growing our team and seeking out world-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.


Role


As Head of Organic Growth, you will own the product-led and content-led strategies that compound our member growth without relying on paid channels. This is a high-leverage, execution-first role for someone who moves fast, thinks in systems, and builds with AI at the center of everything they do.

We are at the stage right before “Function = Health” becomes a common mental shortcut. Your job is to make Function the default answer wherever people ask health questions — Google, AI assistants, YouTube, and their own family group chats.
You will own three pillars:

01 K-FACTOR & VIRALITY
Increase member-to-member spread through referral programs, in-product sharing moments, and social proof mechanics that turn our members into our most effective channel.

02 FUNNEL & CRO
Maximize conversion and revenue through website, app, product, and lifecycle funnels — from first touch to paid member to advocate — continuously testing, learning, and improving.

03 SEARCH EVERYWHERE: SEO, GEO & YOUTUBE
Build and maintain organic discovery authority across traditional search, AI-driven answers, and YouTube — the world's second-largest search engine — ensuring Function surfaces where and how people research their health.


Key Responsibilities


You'll report directly to the VP of Growth and lead the three organic growth pillars that determine how Function scales sustainably. This is not a strategy-and-slide-deck role. You'll be deep in the work — running experiments, writing briefs, reviewing funnels, and shipping — while building the team and systems around you. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Lifecycle, and Creative leadership.

VIRALITY & K-FACTOR

  • Design, launch, and iterate on referral programs that meaningfully increase k-factor, building mechanics into the product and member experience.
  • Map and shrink viral cycle time: instrument every referral surface, identify where member-to-member spread breaks down, and compress the time between a member's first great experience and their first successful referral.
  • Partner with Product to build shareable moments natively into the experience — health is multiplayer, and moments like biological age results are made to be shared. Turn members into our most effective growth channel.

FUNNEL & CRO

  • Guide conversion from account creation to paid member: identify friction points, prioritize the highest-leverage interventions, and close the gap through structured experimentation.
  • Lead A/B testing cadence across web, checkout, onboarding, and lifecycle, with clear statistical discipline and fast learning loops.
  • Instrument and recover drop-offs at every funnel stage, segmenting by cohort, persona, and intent signal to design recovery flows that bring high-intent leads back before they go cold.
  • As Function expands access with lower-friction entry points, own the organic loops that convert new audiences into paying members.

SEARCH EVERYWHERE: SEO, GEO & YOUTUBE

  • Build Function's authority in the category it's creating — own the health education queries that pull people toward continuous, proactive health before they've ever heard of us.
  • Ensure Function shows up where and how people search, across traditional engines and AI-driven discovery tools, with a site and content architecture built to support it.
  • Own YouTube discoverability: build an intent-driven video strategy that treats YouTube as a search engine — keyword and question research, titles, thumbnails, chapters, and channel architecture — partnering with Creative to turn Function's health education into content that both educates and entertains.
  • Develop a content strategy grounded in genuine health information authority that earns trust before a member ever sees a paywall.

MEASUREMENT, TEAM & OPERATIONS

  • Build attribution models across referral, search, video, and lifecycle-driven growth with enough precision to drive real investment decisions.
  • Recruit, manage, and develop a lean team of specialists and external partners — you set the standard, not just manage to it.
  • Use AI tools natively across research, content production, experimentation, and operations, setting the model for how the Growth team works.


Qualifications:


AI-FORWARD OPERATOR REQUIRED

  • 10+ years in organic growth, SEO, or product-led growth, with a track record of compounding results.
  • Hands-on operator who runs experiments themselves — not just directs others to run them.
  • Deep technical SEO fluency: crawl architecture, Core Web Vitals, schema, indexing strategy, and log-file analysis.
  • Fluent in GEO and AI-driven search: how LLMs surface brands, what signals matter, and how to earn placement.
  • Experience growing YouTube or video as an organic discovery channel — video SEO, packaging (titles, thumbnails, hooks), and audience retention mechanics.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or scaling referral programs with measurable k-factor impact.
  • Strong CRO chops — A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, funnel decomposition.
  • Proficient with analytics and experimentation tools (GA4, Amplitude, Looker, or equivalent); can pull and interpret your own data.
  • Uses AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Cursor, etc. — as a genuine force multiplier, not a novelty.
  • Experience building or managing small, high-output teams and agency/contractor relationships.
  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage growth environment: ambiguous, fast, high-ownership.
  • Strong written communicator who can simplify complex growth concepts for cross-functional and executive audiences.
  • Experience in health, wellness, consumer subscription, or another high-trust category is a plus.


Location


We are a remote-first organization that meets quarterly for team onsites in person. Our team is primarily based in the New York and Los Angeles areas, and our onsites are mostly held in NYC, though occasional travel may be expected. New York Tri-State area candidates are preferred but not required.


To be a strong fit, you embody our Core Values


  • Ruthless Prioritization:
    • We don’t let perfect get in the way of progress.
    • We move quickly to drive value, not perfection.
    • We prioritize what drives impact.
    • We never compromise on standards of excellence.
  • Member-First, Always:
    • We design and deliver like we’re caring for someone we love.
    • We create calendar, actionable, human experience.
    • We prioritize responsiveness, peace of mind, and outcomes.
    • We empower members with truth, clarity, and care.
  • One Team, Moving Fast:
    • We are aligned in purpose, prioritization, and speed.
    • We gather diverse perspectives to make informed decisions.
    • We clear paths for each other and move fast together.
    • We communicate clearly and respectfully, rallying around shared goals.
  • Radical Ownership, Relentless Execution:
    • We don’t just ship– we own outcomes and drive results.
    • We act with urgency and precision
    • We anticipate, initiate, and follow through.
    • We meet challenges with grit and pragmatism.
    • We embrace new tech to deliver better outcomes.
  • Mission Over Ego:
    • We are ruthlessly aligned to our mission - and leave ego at the door.
    • We disagree and commit.
    • We don't tolerate politics or withholding information.
    • We operate with honesty, transparency, and respect.
  • Sustained Integrity in Every Detail:
    • We earn trust by obsessing over accuracy, quality, and clarity in everything we do.
    • We prioritize clinical precision - data must be right.
    • We sweat the details because outcomes depend on them.


Why You'll Love Working With Us


We value our team at Function and offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible working hours, and a dynamic work environment where creativity and innovation are encouraged. If you are a highly motivated and experienced individual who is passionate about using technology to improve people’s lives, we would love to hear from you.

At Function, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender identity, ancestry, religion, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital status, Veteran status, or any other occupationally irrelevant criteria.

If you ever have doubts about the legitimacy of a communication, please reach out to us directly at talent@functionhealth.com.

title: Field Technician I
description:
The Field Technician is responsible for collecting samples, observation, and/or inspection of products or raw materials for laboratory analysis by performing the following duties.

• Works under immediate supervision to perform job functions.

•Collects samples as product and or raw materials that are being transferred to containers, vessels, barges, trucks, and/or rail.

• Ensures sample containers and all related paperwork are labeled with identifying data, location of sample, date, and time of collection.

• Delivers sample to laboratory for analysis.

• Performs preparation of samples, reduction and division of appropriate sizes.

• Gathers samples at specified locations, states of processing and time interval.

• Performs sample screening and/or other related physical tests.

• Ensures all equipment and containers are organized and cleaned before and after use.

• Ensures all personal protective equipment (PPE) relevant for tasks is worn at all times.

• Ensures compliance with all required local and federal safety processes and procedures.

• May also have Preparation or Laboratory responsibilities, as required by business needs.

• Adheres to internal standards, policies and procedures.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

Day shift, 8am-4pm. May be some overtime.

• High School or equivalent Required

• No experience required, unless required by state law Required

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS

• A valid and current Driver’s license may be required if the role requires driving a company vehicle. Required

• May be required to obtain a TWIC (Transportation Worker Identification Card). Required

• May be required to obtain 24-hour surface Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) certificate, training is available through SGS. Required

TRAVEL

•Local day travel may be required; may be required to travel overnight occasionally.

EQUIPMENT

• This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones.

• This role may use sample prep equipment that may include Jaw Crusher, Bowl & Disc Pulverizing Mills, Pressure Filters, Riffle Splitters, Compressed Air, Hammer Mill Crushers, Ovens, Balances, and basic sampling tools.

title: Associate Director, Meeting Services
description:
WHAT DOES AN ASSOCIATE DIRECTOR, MEETING SERVICES DO?

THE POSITION:

The Associate Director, Meeting Services may be responsible for the management of team members within the department or lead clients under the supervision of the VP, Meeting Services. Responsible for achieving financial objectives by accurately forecasting hours for themself and team members assigned and pass-through costs on assigned projects. The Associate Director is also responsible for leading a higher volume of planning meetings and managing clients for logistics projects. This role is responsible for contributing and supervising strategically and tactically on assigned accounts, as appropriate for Meeting Services.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Being responsible for managing all program logistics, including but not limited to venue/site selection, contract negotiations, travel, food and beverage, meeting room sets, audio-visual and production, hotel rooming lists, ground transportation, and ancillary vendors (i.e., entertainment, activities, décor, photographer)

  • Being responsible for independent planning, organizing, and seamless execution of high-quality virtual event meetings with multimedia components. Including but not limited to:

  • Virtual platform configuration

  • Manage technology vendor

  • Schedule and execute rehearsals to ensure all parties are prepared for success

  • Attendee management and communication

  • Offer assistance and guidance with any attendee connection issues, as well as basic technical support during an event and to the client

  • Building and customizing registration websites and recruitment material templates with program-specific information and coordinating distribution to all attendees according to necessary timelines

  • Ensuring the highest standards of quality control of client materials and, as appropriate, developing best practices protocols for project teams to facilitate such quality control

  • Being responsible for the oversight and management of program recruitment and attendee management

  • Reviewing and approving meeting specifications from all perspectives such as attendees, vendors, etc., and offering recommendations to reduce costs

  • Providing standard and customized reports to clients at specified intervals

  • Being responsible for attending and participating in new project briefings and kick-off meetings

  • Attending multiple internal meetings with Client Services, Meeting Services, and other key personnel to discuss project status, etc.

  • Working on-site and leading the logistics team at large meetings to coordinate meeting logistics/ activities with Client Services, venue, and vendors, and offer assistance to team members

  • Reviewing and reconciling final invoices and pass-through costs within the mandated timelines

  • Tracking and preparing accurate attendee spend reports to comply with the Open Payment Guidelines

  • Maintaining ongoing dialog with the line manager and project team throughout the life of the program to evaluate progress and initiate the scope change process, if necessary

  • Negotiating the best available rates and contract terms with vendors for owned meetings such as hotel F&B, A/V, ground, etc.

  • Owning the budget (hours & OOP) on assigned meetings and advising the project team of the possible risks. Discussing with the client the challenges and recommendations for correction

  • Identifying operational change opportunities to improve program execution or increase efficiency and/or decrease costs and elevating and owning the potential plan to management.

  • Thorough knowledge and experience of a client, being able to build a budget for a requested meeting based on provided parameters

  • Ability to represent position level on a pitch and explain the appropriate responsibilities to the potential client

  • May be responsible for the relationship of the key vendor for the meeting team, including negotiation and contract review.

  • If a people manager, being responsible for career development, training, and mentoring.

  • Direct report responsibility of forecasting hours and reporting of high/low risks to the VP

  • Maintaining and/or exceeding minimum billable utilization percentages for the position level

  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

  • All other duties as assigned

PEOPLE LEADER

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities:

  • Responsible for and oversee their respective department.

  • Interview, select and supervise the activities of the department staff; communicate interpret and discuss with team the company policies and procedures.

  • Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives discussion appraisal with each employee and performance; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline, and discharge and administer all other personnel actions.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel (35%)

  • Hours (40 hours per week, M-F). Meeting planner role for live meetings; will be required to work outside the standard hours, including evenings and weekends for live events.

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or 8 years in a pharmaceutical hospitality role.

  • Experience and/or Training: Planning for live, virtual, or hybrid meetings; knowledge of hotel bookings and air travel

  • Licenses/Certificates: CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) is preferred but not required

  • Technology/Equipment: Cvent or another similar registration platform, Excel

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or 8 years in a pharmaceutical hospitality role.

  • Experience and/or Training: Planning for live, virtual, or hybrid meetings; knowledge of hotel bookings and air travel

  • Licenses/Certificates: CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) is preferred but not required

  • Technology/Equipment: Cvent or another similar registration platform, Excel

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

The physical and mental requirements along with the work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

Office: While performing the essential functions of this job the employee is frequently required to reach, grasp, stand and/or sit for long periods of time (up to 90% of the shift), walk, talk and hear; occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately quiet, with frequent interruptions and multiple demands.

title: Human Factors Specialist
description:
Human Factors Specialist

Hybrid working with travel across Rail Services locations required

Reporting to: Head of Safety - Arriva Rail Services
Contract: Permanent
Location: Flexible / Hybrid

Arriva Rail Services brings together a range of rail businesses that support the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of rail transport services across the UK. Safety is at the heart of everything we do, and we are committed to continuously improving safety performance, operational effectiveness and colleague wellbeing through innovation and industry best practice.

We have an exciting opportunity to join our Rail Services Safety team as a Human Factors Specialist. In this role, you will support the implementation, monitoring and continual improvement of our Human Factors Strategy, providing specialist expertise, operational support and coaching to leaders and frontline teams across the business.

The Role - Human Factors Specialist

Reporting to the Head of Safety, you will play a key role in embedding Human Factors principles across Rail Services, helping to improve safety performance, operational effectiveness and workforce wellbeing. Working closely with operational managers, engineering teams and HSEQ professionals, you will deliver Human Factors programmes, support investigations, facilitate learning activities and provide data-driven insights that drive continuous improvement.

Key Accountabilities

  • Support the delivery of the Rail Services Human Factors Strategy and Human Factors Integration programme.

  • Provide specialist Human Factors expertise to operational and engineering teams.

  • Coordinate and support Human Factors assessments across Rail Services operations.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, human performance and operational effectiveness.

  • Support investigations and learning activities using Human Factors methodologies.

  • Develop reporting, dashboards and trend analysis to support governance and decision-making.

  • Build Human Factors capability through coaching, awareness and training activities.

  • Support fatigue, workload, ergonomics and organisational change programmes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development and maintenance of Human Factors standards within the Rail Services Safety Management System.

  • Facilitate Human Factors assessments for operational and maintenance activities to optimise safety and efficiency.

  • Coordinate assessments relating to workstation design, shift patterns, workload and working practices.

  • Support business growth and organisational change projects by ensuring Human Factors principles are embedded throughout.

  • Monitor Human Factors improvement projects and coordinate associated action plans.

  • Facilitate Learning Teams and support the sharing of safety learning across the business.

  • Support investigations using recognised Human Factors techniques.

  • Produce Human Factors performance reports, dashboards, KPI reporting and trend analysis.

  • Develop toolbox talks, awareness materials and learning resources.

  • Coach managers and operational leaders in the practical application of Human Factors principles.

  • Maintain Human Factors standards, guidance and templates.

  • Represent Rail Services in internal and external industry working groups and forums.

Our Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Psychology or a related discipline.

  • Experience supporting operational improvement initiatives and applying Human Factors principles within complex operational environments.

  • Practical experience using Human Factors methodologies such as HEART, SHERPA, Task Analysis, Workload Analysis, Learning Teams, Human Error Analysis or Ergonomic Assessments.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and coach others.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate findings into practical improvements.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and data analysis tools.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and functions within a diverse operational environment.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience within rail, transport, engineering or other high-hazard industries.

  • Knowledge of RSSB Human Factors guidance.

  • Knowledge of ORR RM3 and Safety Management Systems.

  • Experience supporting investigations.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Power BI.

Why Join Arriva Rail Services?

This is an opportunity to influence safety, human performance and operational excellence across a diverse rail services portfolio. You'll work with operational leaders, safety professionals and industry stakeholders to deliver meaningful improvements that enhance both safety outcomes and colleague wellbeing.

Whether you're already working within the rail sector or looking to bring your Human Factors expertise from aviation, defence, manufacturing, energy or another safety-critical environment, you'll have the opportunity to make a visible impact across the business.

How to Apply

All applications for this vacancy are to be submitted online. If you have applied and been rejected for this role or a role with a similar skill set in the last 6 months, we will not re-consider you for this position. After 6 months, we will treat your application as a new one.

Due to the energising nature of our vacancies, application close dates, when stated, are indicative and may be subject to change so please apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Shortlisting of applications and interviews for this role will take place while the advert is live; the advert will close once the successful candidate is found. Candidates are therefore encouraged to submit applications as soon as possible.

We acknowledge the importance of our people's diverse experiences, talents and cultures. Embracing diversity and inclusion is a key component of our talent strategy. The creation of a diverse, inclusive workforce is central to our ability to unlock potential and enhance our success.

title: Senior Crop Insurance Adjuster
description:
As one of the leading writers of Federal Crop Insurance, AgriSompo North America combines industry experience, resources, capital and talent to deliver both traditional and innovative crop insurance and productivity tools to farmers, ranchers, insurers and agribusinesses in the United States. Our organization operates within a culture rooted in ethics, integrity and a belief that accountability, collaboration and agility are crucial to long-term success.

AgriSompo North America is a part of AgriSompo, Sompo International’s global agriculture platform. This platform is an integrated underwriting, technology and distribution platform delivering innovate insurance and reinsurance solutions to agriculture partners worldwide. Sompo International, AgriSompo’s parent company, is a global organization driven by its core values, a carrier that holds promise, trust and the commitment to protect. Through operating subsidiaries, Sompo International writes agriculture, casualty and other specialty, professional lines, property, marine/energy and aviation lines of insurance and catastrophe, property, casualty, professional lines and specialty lines of reinsurance.

As a leading provider of crop insurance and other agricultural risk management tools, we recognize that our success is derived directly from those whose contributions matter most: our people. AgriSompo North America has major offices in Lenexa, Kansas and Des Moines, Iowa as well as regional offices around the country. A shared commitment to integrity, accountability, collaboration and agility define our culture, and we strive to create exceptional value for our clients and shareholders and maintain AgriSompo North America as a desirable place to work.

Job Description

Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has an unique opportunity for a Senior Crop Insurance Adjuster to support our Multi-Peril Crop Insurance (MPCI), Private Products and Named Peril claims group.

Location: This position will be based remotely in Texas, with preference for candidates located in Amarillo or the greater Texas Panhandle region. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environment where our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity:

What you’ll be doing:

  • Actual responsibilities will vary depending on daily needs and type of customer supported
  • Build and maintain professional relationships with the Area Claim Supervisor, policyholders, agents, and other adjusters
  • Record and transmit loss information to accurately determine potential damages in accordance to established loss adjustment procedures (FCIC, NCIS and Company)
  • Complete field inspections, read maps and aerial imagery, measure fields and measure storage bins
  • Utilize company software proficiently including daily monitoring of all company communications
  • Follow FCIS, State, and Company rules and regulations, policies, and procedures for MPCI and Private Products
  • Complete initial and ongoing training and certifications as required by FCIC and State Regulations
  • Explain adjusting procedures and related findings to the policyholder and agent
  • Perform fact-finding and investigate crop damage, record information, and transmit information to accurately determine potential indemnities
  • Train field claims staff on claim procedures, best practices, and compliance standards
  • Willingness to learn new crops

What you’ll bring:

  • Preferred 5 years' as a crop insurance adjuster.
  • Preferred 5 years’ experience handling crop insurance claims.
  • Required license and certification: CAPP certification and valid driver’s license with a satisfactory driving record and applicable State license.
  • High school diploma or equivalent, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in agriculture preferred, but not required.
  • Basic mathematical skills (add, subtract, multiply, divide).
  • Effective interpersonal, oral and written communication skills with the ability to interact with all levels of people within and outside the organization.
  • Ability to complete documentation requirements.
  • Ability to utilize analytical thinking; find facts and solve problems.
  • Ability to remain self-motivated and efficient.
  • Ability to work both in an office setting and outdoors in a farm environment.
  • Ability to work well both independently and within a team environment.
  • Ability to remain focused on exceptional customer service, both internally and externally.
  • Working knowledge of crop insurance regulations, policies, procedures and best practices.
  • Works effectively under pressure and able to work within tight deadlines.
  • Willingness to take initiative and work with minimal supervision.
  • Strong time management skills with ability to prioritize.

Physical Requirements & Work Conditions

  • Ability to lift/push/pull up to 50 lbs. occasionally; including ladders, bushels, ramps for off road vehicles.
  • Ability to walk in agricultural fields, up to 3 miles.
  • Ability to climb agricultural storage bins, up to 75 feet.
  • Ability to climb, crawl, stoop, kneel and balance.
  • Ability to climb ladders and perform work at significant heights.
  • Ability to perform work in confined spaces.
  • Ability to work outside in extreme weather conditions.
  • Ability to work in an environment with high dust levels around grain and other bulk products.
  • Ability to meet requirement of and utilize all applicable PPE, when applicable.
  • Ability to work extended hours, weekend, holidays and/or as needed.
  • Uses peripheral vision and depth perception for tasks being performed.

Environmental Conditions

The work environment described is intended to represent the typical conditions an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this role. The physical environment requires work in both indoor and outdoor settings, including exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, humidity, and dryness. Use of personal protective equipment is frequently required.

This role also involves up to 50% travel, primarily within a two-hour driving distance from the assigned home office. Occasional out-of-town travel may be necessary for trainings and meetings.

Actual compensation for this role will depend on several factors including the cost of living associated with your work location, your qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

Our compensation program is built on a foundation that promotes a pay-for-performance culture, resulting in higher incentive awards, on average, when the Company does well and lower incentive awards when the Company underperforms. title: Project Manager (Integrated Child Protection, Health and Child Poverty)
description:
Project Manager (Integrated Child Protection, Health and Child Poverty)

Location: Myanmar

VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT
ROLE PROFILE
TITLE: Project Manager (Integrated Child Protection, Health and Child Poverty) (FOR MYANMAR NATIONAL ONLY)
TEAM/PROGRAMME: Humanitarian
LOCATION: Yangon, Head Office
Number of Position: 1
GRADE: NAT-2
CONTRACT LENGTH: Fixed Term

CHILD SAFEGUARDING:

Level 3: the post holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work country programs; or are visiting country programs; or because they are responsible for implementing the vetting process staff.

ROLE PURPOSE:

The post holder will provide leadership, programme management, and team management; ensuring timely and efficient implementation of the multi sectoral and integrated interventions in child protection, health and child poverty project.

The PM ensures that the project is implemented in line with agreed plans and quality standard. The PM ensures that the project has appropriate M&E plans that link to the programme wide MEAL system and that experience and learning from the delivery of projects contributes to advocacy work and informs ongoing project and programme design. The PM will lead coordination and liaison with partner organizations, key stakeholders in target areas as well as UN organizations. The PM will ensure building capacity of the project team and partner organizations in coordination with the Thematic Lead, Advisors and Senior Program Manager. In the event of a major humanitarian emergency, the role holder will be expected to work outside the normal role profile and be able to vary working hours accordingly. The PM has the primary responsibility for periodic donor narrative and financial reports and also ensures that project reports are prepared to a high quality and submitted on time in line with SCI and donor compliance.

SCOPE OF ROLE:

Reports to: Senior Program Manager

Direct Reports: 1Project Coordinator, 1 MEAL Coordinator, 3 Project Officer

Budget Responsibility: Yes, budget oversight for the project

Financial Approval: Budget Allocation on General Funds up to 20,000 USD

External Representation: Interpersonal contact regular and varied in both oral and written. Negotiation and representation with senior level representatives including government level decision makers, donors, wider SC community

Travel: Occasional (up to 5 days every month)

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY :

Project Management:
• Overall responsible for the management and implementation and quality of integrated project activities and staff;
• Ensure the effective and efficient implementation of the integrated programme.
• Manage the integrated programme implementation, including financial management, to ensure timely delivery of programme activities (for example, phased budgets, procurement planning, monitoring against log frames, financial and budget management, performance management and partner support).
• Produce monthly data and regular narrative reports for different stakeholders as well as donor narrative reports of high quality (in collaboration with the Senior Programme Manager and the Thematic Lead and Advisors) in timely manner
• Prepare timely programme and donor reports on the project activities in compliance with internal Save the Children requirements and any relevant external donor requirements.
• Working closely with the Program Advisor support the development of high quality concept notes and proposals
• Coordinate with the supply chain team to put in place a phased procurement plan for all grants
• Working closely with the Monitoring & Evaluation team put in place a sector M & E plan, ensuring this links to reporting requirements, and capacity build technical field staff in carrying out the work.
• Coordination with government counterparts and other stakeholders including members Provide guidance and technical support to the teams involved in the process Ensure project staff safety and security, and ensure all Save the Children policies and principles are upheld.

Grant Management
• Primary budget-holding responsibility for the fund related to the project;
• Lead the discussion on the budget of the grant at the monthly Finance & Grant meetings in the office
• Maintain a close relationship with the Finance & Award team on this grant, and in particular when rephrase or revise budgets as required, and formally approve the budget change decisions.
• Monitor the project to ensure that it is managed in line with the agreed budget, and that transactions comply with Save the Children’s and the donor’s financial and compliance policies.
• Monitor and discuss budget variances with the relevant team members, and ensure that variance issues are corrected speedily and expenditures are in line with work plan.
• Develop timely solutions to project’s under and overspends in line with SC Member and donor requirements
• Check and approve the financial reports (produced by the Funding & Grants team).

Leverages digital tools, including ChatGPT and other AI-enabled technologies, to enhance provider communication, improve workflow efficiency, support documentation, and identify opportunities to strengthen the overall provider experience.

  • Promote and assist providers with enrolling in the Zelis ZAPP EDGE solution.

  • Educate providers on the benefits of the Zelis Provider Portal.

  • Use ChatGPT and AI tools, where appropriate and in accordance with company policies, to support provider communications, summarize interactions, draft follow-up messaging, streamline research, and improve operational efficiency.

  • Leverage AI-assisted insights to identify trends, recurring provider questions, and opportunities to improve engagement and retention strategies.

  • Maintain awareness of and ensure adherence to ZELIS PAYMENTS standards regarding privacy, confidentiality, and responsible use of AI technologies.

  • Accountable for day-to-day tasks.

  • Must have professional manner and respect the confidentiality of provider information.

  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks.

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to use ChatGPT, AI tools, and other technology resources responsibly and effectively to support daily responsibilities.

PROBLEM SOLVING:

  • Excellent organizational skills are required to prioritize responsibilities, thus completing work in a timely fashion.

  • Attention to detail and concern for impact is essential.

  • Ability to apply AI-supported tools, including ChatGPT, to enhance problem-solving, communication, and process efficiency while maintaining accuracy and compliance.

  • HS Diploma & 1-3 yrs

  • Requires proficiency using AI tools skillfully with an understanding of how to develop/create intelligent prompts and/or agents.

  • Demonstrates advanced organizational and documentation skills across multiple concurrent projects.

  • Communicates effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and adept at learning and applying new tools and technologies.

  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Works independently with minimal supervision and contributes actively to team success.

  • Excellent telephone and client service skills

  • Has proficiency in tele-sales and marketing techniques yielding increased product usage

title: Data Analytics Manager
description:
Data Analytics Manager

Location: Brooklyn, NY (Rent the Runway HQ)

Department: Analytics

Manager, Data Analytics

About Us:

Rent the Runway (RTR) is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world’s first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in-house proprietary technology and a one-of-a-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC’s “Disruptor 50” five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies list multiple times.

About the Team:

Data is core to our growing business and has been ingrained in the company's DNA since its founding. As a member of the Data Analytics team, you will arm stakeholders with data to measure performance, insights, and drive continuous improvements across the company. The team is responsible for developing and maintaining RTR’s core data models, defining and analyzing performance metrics, building reports, and enabling self-service report solutions. Business Intelligence is an important team within the RTR Customer organization.

About the Job:

We are looking for a Data Analytics Manager to lead high-impact analytics initiatives and manage key data models that describe our customers and business. In this role, you will partner cross-functionally with business leaders across the organization. You will own the creation of rich reporting and data visualizations, enabling functional leaders to quickly digest information and make data-driven decisions. In collaboration, you will define KPIs and set attainable, stretch goals to drive continuous improvement. You will be a key contributor to the culture of the team, and you will have opportunities for growth and leadership as we expand. This role will require strong analytical judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment. The role will be an individual contributor (IC) to start, and will evolve into people leadership over time.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead strategic analytics initiatives by partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify, scope, and fill data visibility gaps.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to ensure we collect the data required to support business objectives
  • Develop scalable, reusable, and well-documented data models that power dashboards, reports, and analysis across the organization
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering to design, optimize, and maintain data pipelines, ensuring data availability, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Analyze key areas of the business to uncover opportunities for optimization, experimentation, and strategic improvements.
  • Define and monitor KPIs to influence decisions throughout RTR
  • Build, maintain, and monitor robust, user-friendly Looker dashboards and reports, ensuring stakeholders have access to up-to-date insights.
  • Drive best practices across the Data Team, including data governance, performance optimization, and documentation.

About You:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with large, complex data sets and delivering analytics solutions in fast-paced or scaled environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics…); advanced degrees and/or specializations a plus.
  • Highly proficient in SQL, with the ability to write efficient, optimized queries for large-scale datasets.
  • Demonstrated experience with data modeling, dimensional modeling, and dbt.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards in Looker or similar BI tools (Sigma, Tableau, etc.).
  • Experience with code management and deployment on GitHub.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead analytics or reporting projects end-to-end, from scoping to stakeholder communication.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences, including business stakeholders, data engineers, and product teams.
  • Experience working with event data or user/product analytics tools (e.g., Heap) is a plus.
  • Passion for data and its fundamental ability to create value.
  • Extremely curious and excited to dive into complex problems.
  • Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable operating with ownership and ambiguity.

Benefits:

At Rent the Runway, we’re committed to the wellbeing of our employees, and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Paid Time Off including vacation, paid bereavement, and family sick leave - every employee needs time to take care of themselves and their family.
  • Universal Paid Parental Leave for both parents + flexible return to work program - because we know your newest family member(s) deserve your undivided attention.
  • Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of continuous service - Unplug, recharge, and have some fun!
  • Exclusive employee subscription and rental discounts - to ensure you experience the magic of renting the runway (and give us valued feedback!).
  • Comprehensive health, vision, dental, FSA and dependent care from day 1 of employment - Your health comes first and we’ve got you covered.
  • 401k match - an investment in your future.
  • Company wide events and outings - our team spirit is no joke - we know how to have fun!
  • Office centric work - our corporate employees and technical leaders have the option to work remotely on Fridays, in accordance with Company policies.

Rent the Runway is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant or employee based on any legally-recognized basis, including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age (40 and over), national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

_________

The anticipated base salary for this position is $160k to $190k. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held.

description:

What you’ll be doing:
As a warehouse associate you may work in one of the following four areas:

Order Picker: You will pick and prepare customer orders accurately and timely to meet daily production goals. At times you will be picking above ground level while adhering to safety procedures.

Restocker: You will scan labels, cut boxes, and restock shelves to prep your work area for the next shift while adhering to safety procedures.

Bulk Selector: You will be responsible for selecting product, pulling, and packing totes, as well as cutting cases of merchandise and/or stocking product. You will move full totes and cases onto a conveyor belt while adhering to safety procedures.

Custodian: You will be responsible for general cleaning and basic maintenance duties both inside and outside of the facility. In this role, you will clean and sanitize restrooms, vacuum, and remove spots from carpet, sweep and mop floors, clean and dust chairs, partition walls and other miscellaneous furniture, clean windows and brass and collect and remove trash from the warehouse while adhering to safety procedures.

Please note, as an SC1 associate you may be moved into any of the above roles as needed.

You will be essential to the success of Staples Supply Chain as we deliver to our customers.

Safety is our utmost priority so, in this role, we will look to you to ensure safe work practices and embrace our safety culture.

What you bring to the table:

  • An ability to count and use basic arithmetic skills.
  • An inclusive approach with your colleagues and customers to forge strong relationships and foster collaboration to resolve issues.
  • An ability to adopt our safety procedures quickly and ensure safe work practices.
  • An ability to work in a warehouse environment with seasonal temperature variations.

What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:

  • Ability to work assigned schedule and be accountable for assigned tasks.
  • Ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.
  • Basic English language skills (both verbal and written communications).
  • If you are hired as a Full-Time associate, you must have the ability to work additional hours beyond scheduled shift; additional overtime hours will be required based on business need.
  • An ability to lift, lower, push, pull or carry product up to a maximum of 70 pounds by hand.
  • Must wear safety composite shoes.
  • Ability to walk and stand 100% of the time.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.


What’s needed- Preferred Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED or equivalent work experience.
  • Prior warehouse or applicable experience to include, but not limited to: fast-food (utilizing headset a plus), stockroom, working with racking systems, customer service, package handling, etc.


The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our team at EPAM Systems in Poland.

This position offers a hybrid work model — combining remote work with 3 days per week from one of our EPAM offices located in Kraków, Wrocław, or Gdańsk. This setup allows you to enjoy flexibility while staying connected with your team and benefiting from in-person collaboration.

If you're at the beginning of your professional journey, have a solid foundation in Java and are eager to learn and grow in a supportive engineering environment — we'd love to meet you. At EPAM, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real-world projects, and accelerate your career from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain software components under the guidance of senior team members using Java and related technologies
  • Write clean, well-structured, and readable code following team coding standards and best practices
  • Implement and consume RESTful APIs as part of application development tasks
  • Write unit tests to ensure correctness and reliability of delivered code
  • Participate in code reviews — both as a reviewer and a contributor — to learn and uphold quality standards
  • Collaborate with team members including developers, QA engineers, and business analysts in an Agile environment
  • Use version control systems to manage code changes and contribute to shared repositories
  • Investigate and resolve bugs and issues reported during testing or production
  • Actively participate in team ceremonies such as stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives
  • Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and approaches to grow professionally and contribute more effectively to the team

Requirements

  • A minimum of 9–12 months of production experience in software development
  • Solid understanding of Java core fundamentals, including experience with Java 21 features and modern language capabilities
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries and working with relational databases
  • Practical experience with JUnit and a strong understanding of unit testing principles and best practices
  • Basic knowledge of REST concepts, including HTTP methods, status codes, and request/response structure
  • Hands-on experience with Git for version control, branching, and collaborative development workflows
  • Very good coding skills with the ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code
  • Working knowledge of Spring Boot for building Java-based applications
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) basics and core cloud concepts
  • Understanding of CI/CD fundamentals — awareness of automated build, test, and deployment pipelines
  • Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and grow within a team-oriented environment
  • Proficiency in English (B2+), both written and spoken

Nice to have

  • Exposure to Google Cloud technologies such as Guice (dependency injection), gRPC, and Protocol Buffers for building efficient service communication
  • Basic knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, or supplementary development tasks
  • Familiarity with Angular basics, including component structure and fundamental frontend development concepts
  • Experience with Claude/Codex/Gemini

Benefits

We gather like-minded people:

  • Top tech minds driving innovation in AI, cloud and digital platform modernization
  • Supportive team and an agile, startup-like culture that accelerates your growth
  • Hybrid work model designed for collaboration, requiring 3 days a week from the office
  • Chance to work abroad for up to 60 days annually

We provide growth opportunities:

  • Career development programs
  • Thought leadership, mentoring, soft skills and well-being programs
  • Certification (Anthropic, Gemini, GCP, Azure, AWS)
  • English classes

We cover it all:

  • Stable pay
  • Participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 15% discount
  • Benefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)
  • Referral bonuses up to $2,000
  • Offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, coffee and more
  • Corporate, social and well-being events

Please, note:

  • We will reach out to selected candidates exclusively

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Job Description:

Saab, Inc. is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented Senior Program Manager to be responsible for the profitable execution of programs within the Product Segment of the Surveillance U.S. Division.

As a global leading partner and provider of proven Air Traffic Monitoring, Safety, and Efficiency solutions, we transform operations, turning innovative ideas into reality and supporting stakeholders from solution conception through long-term support.

This position would be based in East Syracuse, NY and is eligible for Saab, Inc's relocation package.

Additional responsibilities of the Senior Program Manager will include, but are not limited to:

  • Specifically accountable for cost, schedule and technical performance of assigned Program portfolio.

  • Establish and control program budgets that are aligned with program needs

  • Establish and control program schedule to meet all program milestones

  • Ensure all projects within assigned program are managed and executed within approved program management processes

  • Identify and manage risks and opportunities across cost, schedule, and technical.

  • Make personnel recommendations in support of business objectives

  • Develop high-quality competitive proposals that facilitate achievement of business segment objectives

  • Collaborate with all functions within the business unit to leverage program execution, capture strategies and resources through the design and manufacturing phases of the programs in the portfolio

  • Grow relationships in the customer community and with large industry primes to service existing programs and find new and unique ways to deploy our technology to meet customer needs

Compensation:

  • $132,000 - $171,600

The compensation range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Saab, Inc. considers factors including (but not limited to) the role and associated responsibilities, location, and market and business considerations, as well as the candidate's work experience, key skills, and education/training.

Skills and Experience:

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree and 12+ years’ experience, OR MA/MS degree and 10+ years’ experience, OR PhD degree and 8+ years’ experience.

  • Experience successfully negotiating multi-million-dollar agreements.

  • Must possess advanced knowledge of program management standards and best practices (scheduling, cost accounting, Risk/Opportunity management).

  • Willingness to travel internationally and domestically up to 10%

  • The ability to work flexible schedule to include evenings.

Desired Qualifications

  • Engineering or technical program management background with progressive program management experience

  • Proficient in Microsoft Project and other Microsoft Office applications

  • Demonstrated experience supporting both defense and commercial products

Citizenship Requirements:

Must be a U.S. citizen, Permanent Resident (green card holder), or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Drug-Free Workplaces:

Saab is a federal government contractor and adheres to policies and programs necessary for sustaining drug-free workplaces. As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screen.

Benefits:

Saab provides an excellent working environment offering professional growth opportunities, competitive wages, work-life balance, a business casual atmosphere and comprehensive benefits.

Highlights include:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance for employees and dependents

  • Generous paid time off, including 8 designated holidays

  • 401(k) with employer contributions

  • Tuition assistance and student loan assistance

  • Wellness and employee assistance resources

  • Employee stock purchase opportunities

  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

About Us:

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. In the U.S., Saab delivers advanced technology and systems, supporting the U.S. Armed Forces and the Federal Aviation Administration, as well as international and commercial partners. Headquartered in Syracuse, New York, the company has business units and local employees in ten U.S. locations.

Saab is a company where we see diversity as an asset and offer unlimited opportunities for advancing in your career. We are also a company that respects each person’s needs and encourage employees to lead a balanced, rewarding life beyond work. Saab values diversity and is an Affirmative Action employer for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Saab is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, all qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran, disability status, or any other federal, state, or locally protected category.

title: Director of Product Management, Adobe Lightroom Creative Pro
description:
The Opportunity


Adobe Lightroom is the world’s leading photography ecosystem, empowering photographers to edit, manage, store, and share images across desktop, mobile, and web.


As professional photography is reshaped by AI, automation, new client expectations, and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape, we are looking for a Director of Product Management to help define what the modern professional photography workflow becomes next.


This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with deep product leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency in professional photography. You will represent the needs of photographers currently engaged with Lightroom, helping teams understand where pros need more speed, quality, trust, creative control, and workflow efficiency. You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy.
Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences.


This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control.


What You’ll Do


Shape the Creative Pro product agenda:
• Lead key product strategy workstreams for the Creative Pro audience across
Lightroom surfaces including desktop, mobile, and web.
• Identify high-value opportunities across professional workflows, including ingest, culling, editing, retouching, masking, batch editing, collaboration, client review, delivery, and archive.
• Translate photographers’ jobs to be done into clear product principles, requirements, priorities, and success measures.
• Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years.

Represent professional photographers inside Adobe:

Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography.
• Build relationships with professional photographers, educators, creators, camera partners, and industry experts to keep Lightroom grounded in real-world workflows.
• Bring hands-on photography fluency into product reviews, prototypes, roadmap discussions, launch planning, and executive conversations.
• Help teams distinguish between technically impressive ideas and experiences professionals will trust in production.

Imagine and ship new experiences
• Partner with teams in advanced technology, design, and engineering to shape new capabilities into experiences photographers love and rely on.
• Define how AI, agents, and automation should show up in Lightroom to save time, improve quality, reduce repetitive work, and expand creative possibility.
• Balance innovation with quality, performance, reliability, transparency, and user
control.
• Drive clarity and alignment across cross-functional teams, strategic forums, planning cycles, and executive discussions.
Ground decisions in insight
• Stay close to the tools, services, communities, and workflows professional photographers use today.
• Develop a strong point of view on where Lightroom should lead, where it should partner, and how we can exceed expectations of our most advanced customers.
• Connect customer insight, product quality, adoption, retention, monetization, and competitive differentiation into precisely structured product recommendations.

What You’ll Need to Succeed


• Proven experience as a senior product leader who has defined strategy and shipped high-impact products, ideally for creative, media, professional, technical, or workflow-intensive customers.
• Deep understanding of professional photography workflows, including speed, quality, consistency, client expectations, high-volume production, and creative control.
• Strong product taste, with the ability to evaluate whether an experience meets the bar for professional use.
• Experience turning ambiguous customer needs, emerging technology, and business goals into well-defined product strategy, tradeoffs, and shipped outcomes.
• Experience partnering deeply with research, design, engineering, and product marketing to deliver customer-facing products at scale.

• Experience with AI, automation, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic experiences, holding a clear stance on trust, control, quality, and user value.
• Executive-level storytelling and influence, especially in senior IC roles where impact depends on alignment rather than direct authority.
• Strong analytical judgment, showing proficiency in combining usage data, customer research, market signals, competitive insight, and hands-on craft expertise.
• Excellent collaboration skills, high ownership, and a demonstrated ability to build trust with photographers and internal partners alike.

Strong Plus
• Over 10 years spent working professionally as a photographer specializing in one or more genres.
• Experience teaching, mentoring, writing for, or building community with photographers.
• Experience collaborating with camera manufacturers, lens makers, imaging hardware companies, or other photography ecosystem partners.
• A photography portfolio, shipped product examples, writing, talks, or other work that demonstrates extensive knowledge of professional creative workflows.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015.

AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

Expected Pay Range:

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $173,800 -- $334,500 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.



In California, the pay range for this position is $231,000 - $334,500


At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans. Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).

In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.
